newsitem.title: USA: Sacramento Kings owner seeks $145mln aid from city.
newsitem.headline: Sacramento Kings owner seeks $145mln aid from city.

text.p: The owner of the Sacramento Kings basketball team has asked city officials to invest $145 million in an existing arena and in a planned sports and entertainment complex, according to a published report on Thursday.
Kings owner Jim Thomas has told city officials that he wants the city to commit the funds or else he may sell the team, Sacramento Bee newspaper reported.
City and team officials were not immediately available to comment on the report.
Thomas asked city officials to put an initiative on the June ballot that would provide the $145 million.
City officials told the Bee they believed about $90 million of that money would allow Thomas to refinance the debt on the nine-year old Arco Arena.
The rest of the money would go into a partnership he proposed with the city to build a sports and entertainment complex adjacent to the Arco Arena, according to the Bee.
